task.problem:
TASK-254 r2 admitted RUN-254-001 and produced a clean, transportable candidate, but Runtime correctly failed the RUN at COMPLETION_GATE because the contract was internally incomplete. The implementation could audit an initial AUTHOR_REPAIR when Unified State projected AUTHOR_REPAIR, but after one REPAIR authorization exists Unified State correctly projects EXECUTE_REPAIR. Existing immutable supersession semantics still permit Human/Brain to replace an obsolete, not-yet-executed repair strategy, yet Flow Resolution and Decision Packet compilation currently require AUTHOR_REPAIR for REPAIR_AUTHORING. Therefore a superseding authorization cannot obtain the fresh audited handoff required by r2 without changing authorities that r2 explicitly placed outside scope.
The exact canonical failure is RUN-254-001 with failure-artifacts commit f5c5582b857ad9bb488d50a0ecaed24051ca19c0 and failed candidate e5eb94205c7d5f9032f61b5e511361f7325699e4. This is a TASK-contract defect rather than an implementation defect repairable inside r2 scope. Revision 3 widens H1 only enough to preserve audited immutable REPAIR supersession without turning Unified State into a correction selector or lifecycle router.
